svg.title: 4K Omarchy frame achieved; Real guest GPU reaches QEMU SDL; two 1800-frame current-driver runs pass; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 gates
svg.desc: Two fresh NVIDIA 621.01 guests pass 1800 GPU handoffs over 33.5 and 33.8 seconds, complete source/window pixel audits, input response and live cleanup. Driver mismatch, memory-pressure and rejected budget-candidate failures remain retained. Physical scanout, input latency, full desktop, DLSS, hardware ray tracing and 93 percent matched-native performance remain unverified. Backend 4 of 8; desktop product 0 of 4. Updated October 22, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Complete GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
Real guest → QEMU SDL: two 1,800-frame NVIDIA 621.01 runs pass full pixel audits
Sustained GPU streams: 33.5–33.8 s · Median CPU handoff: 17.1–17.3 ms
Next: safe memory-pressure handling, displayed cadence and official physical input
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-22
Real guest GPU source: 3840×2160 · SDL backbuffer: 2560×1566 · Physical 4K scanout unverified
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
